item.title: Kinectron + p5.js — sketch controls and GIF export
item.description: For a creative-coding class I needed Kinectron skeleton data inside p5.js, with simple play / stop controls and a way to export a short GIF for demos. Notes below are the skeleton I used (Kinect v2 or Azure Kinect DK, Kinectron server running).
